expected_time.refuted: core_halo: 129/216 of training cases fail, 65/108 held out; layered: 40/216 of training cases fail, 24/108 held out; porphyry: 15/216 of training cases fail, 4/108 held out; vein: 126/216 of training cases fail, 77/108 held out. The failures concentrate in vein, and they do so on BOTH splits, which is what the first and much narrower sweep could not show: with five scenarios running rate and capacity together at a correlation of -0.735, the scenario looked like the cause and the orebody looked refuted.
expected_time.target_relaxation: the tightest single-resource relaxation, as the ExTS rung uses
expected_time.split: by deposit seed, never by row

bound.split: by deposit seed, never by row
bound.monotone_note: more capacity cannot lower an LP bound and a higher discount rate cannot raise it. Measured per held-out deposit by holding everything else and sweeping one feature.

honesty: Neither model certifies anything. The certified bound always comes from the critical multiplier algorithm or from Bienstock-Zuckerberg; these are scored against the exact quantity they approximate, on deposits they never saw, split by deposit seed.
